report.title: Feature Request: Automatically Convert HEIC/HEIF Images to JPEG on Upload
report.body:
### Check before submitting

- [x] I searched existing issues and did not find a duplicate

### What problem would this solve?

Many modern smartphones, especially iPhones, use HEIC/HEIF as their default photo format.

When uploading photos directly from a mobile device to Memos, HEIC images may not be displayed consistently across different browsers and devices due to limited HEIC support.

Currently, users may need to manually convert HEIC photos to JPEG before uploading them. This adds unnecessary steps and makes the mobile experience less convenient.

I would like to upload photos directly from my phone without worrying about image format compatibility.

### What would you like to happen?

I would like Memos to automatically detect and convert HEIC/HEIF images to JPEG during the upload process.

Ideally, the following behavior should be supported:

- Automatically detect HEIC/HEIF files when uploading images.

- Convert them to JPEG before storing them.

- Support both photos selected from the device's gallery and photos taken directly using the mobile device's camera.

- Preserve the original image orientation (EXIF Orientation).

- Maintain reasonable image quality while optimizing file size.

- Preserve relevant EXIF metadata where technically feasible.

- Leave existing upload behavior unchanged for JPEG, PNG, WebP, and other supported formats.

The conversion should happen transparently without requiring any additional action from the user. Server-side conversion would be preferable to ensure consistent behavior across different mobile devices and browsers.

### Additional context

This feature would be particularly useful for iPhone users because iOS commonly uses HEIC as the default photo format.

A possible workaround today is to manually convert HEIC images to JPEG before uploading them, but this is inconvenient when frequently creating memos with photos.

Related existing HEIC issues:

- https://github.com/usememos/memos/issues/70

- https://github.com/usememos/memos/issues/625

These issues discuss HEIC image compatibility and display problems. This feature request is specifically about automatically converting HEIC/HEIF images to JPEG during upload, rather than simply supporting HEIC image display.
